content:
name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - node: 18
            pnpm: 10
          - node: 20
            pnpm: 10
          - node: 22
            pnpm: 11
          - node: 24
            pnpm: 11
          - node: 26
            pnpm: 11

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
        with:
          version: ${{ matrix.pnpm }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: pnpm

      - run: pnpm install
      - run: pnpm test
